test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who received the Padma Vibhushan in the field of art in the year 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri Chhannulal Mishra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2020, **Channulal Mishra**, together with six others, received the country's second-highest civilian award, the Padma Vibhusan.
 
• In 2015, he was also named as one of the PM's 'Navratnas' for the Clean India Campaign.
 
• **Sur Singar Sansad's 'Shiromani Award' **has also been bestowed upon him.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Balwant Moreshwar "Babasaheb" Purandare** was a Maharashtra-based Indian historian and theatre celebrity. On January 25, 2019, he was honoured with the Padma Vibhushan, India's second-highest civilian honour.
 
• **Pandit Budhaditya Mukherjee **is a master of the Imdadkhani gharana (school) of Indian classical sitar and surbahar. He is known for his nuanced vocalic playing and outstanding high-speed playing.
 
• **Mohanlal Viswanathan** is an Indian actor, film producer, playback singer, television personality, and film distributor who is most known for his work in Malayalam films, though he has also acted in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Hindi films.
